routing.COMMON_GLOBAL_NORMALIZATION_AND_Y_ROW_DI: All pinned-source, exact action, EH control, all-row Y variation, sign, and no-fitted-param checks pass. Freeze a new versioned analytic Y dictionary; never silently alter historical results or run Z21.
routing.ACTION_NORMALIZATION_OR_VARIATION_UNRESO: Any action anchor, equality or sign cannot be proved from pinned sources; freeze specific failed identity and do not add source terms.

thresholds: Exact symbolic equalities only. No observational or numerical science thresholds are changed.
